title: Unable to Duplicate or Troubleshoot Issues
summary: This topic centers on dealers, technicians, or users being unable to duplicate problems, detect faults, complete troubleshooting, or access desired functions, with many fragments lacking enough context to determine sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe technicians or dealers being unable to duplicate reported problems or detect faults, and one complaint about inaccessible charging options.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention inability to perform setup, troubleshooting, remote diagnostics, or other actions, but the fragments do not provide enough context to confirm the overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are short and lack context, so sentiment is undetermined in many cases.
The topic mixes service-diagnosis failures with unrelated usability, setup, remote access, and charging-access issues rather than one clearly uniform subject.
Examples are insufficient to identify the underlying root causes of the reported inability to duplicate or complete tasks.
